reviews.title: Fast, Compatible, and Great Value!
reviews.comment: Snapped right into my motherboard and XMP kicked in first try at 6000MHz — no fuss, no tweaking. Temps stay cool at 1.35V and the system is noticeably snappier. Solid DDR5 kit at a fair price. Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Lynn Volpato
